verdict.rationale: Canny publishes an API Reference and an official MCP server that can query feedback, roadmap and ARR themes, and take actions such as updating statuses, linking deals, organizing requests and replying to customers. Nothing in the evidence shows the API covers everything the UI does, and no OpenAPI spec was found at any probed path. Missing for 10: documented UI-to-API parity, endpoint-level detail on API coverage (e.g., changelog, Autopilot, settings/admin), a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on corroboration.
